parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit correctly addresses both error targets: it removes the mischaracterization of the action as 'concrete' by noting the comment lacks implementation details (no suggested experiments/ablation/analyses), and it replaces the erroneous score mapping to level 5 with a description of the action as 'explicit but vague on how to execute it,' without stating a numeric score. Unrelated correct reasoning (clarification questions treated as explicit statements, authors can identify what is missing) is preserved. No evidence is invented. The rationale is coherent and suitable to insert into rescoring without leaking a numeric label.
